verdict.rationale: Box documents a broad REST API that covers the core UI functions: chunked uploads, shared links, collaborations/permissions, search, metadata, webhooks, events, Box AI, and Box Sign. Box Sign is explicitly described as bringing 'the full Box Sign web app experience' to the API. However, no evidence asserts general UI-to-API parity, and there is no independent verification of complete coverage. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of full UI/API parity, coverage evidence for admin/governance and other UI features beyond the listed areas, and independent or hands-on corroboration that nothing in the UI is API-unreachable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Box Sign brings the full Box Sign web app experience to your application through the API.
The Chunked Upload API provides a way to reliably upload large files to Box by chunking them into a sequence of parts that can be uploaded individually.
Collaborations define access permissions for users and groups on files and folders, similar to access control lists.
The Box API provides a way to find content in Box using full-text search queries.
Define and store custom key-value data on files and folders using metadata templates, instances, cascade policies, and queries.
Use the Box AI API to ask questions, extract metadata, and summarize files stored in Box.
